dispositionUsed.note: Phase-27 Obgleich false-positive verdict is REVOKED per Phase 29; those 3 are included here as DATA/AUTHORING

sharedRootCause.title: One renderer asymmetry generates every one of the 21
sharedRootCause.spanSide: chapter-app.js:2862 — const spanRole = roleFor(word, null, isSentenceInitial(...)); span.className = ('de-link ' + spanRole).trim(). For an auto-linkified word there is no authored token, so roleFor falls through to guessRole.
sharedRootCause.guessRole: chapter-app.js:735-754, a pure SURFACE heuristic in this order: (1) known chapter adjective stem + strong ending → r-adjective; (2) /^[A-ZÄÖÜ]/ → r-object; (3) lich|ig|isch|bar|sam|los|haft|voll|ell|iv → r-adjective; (4) er|es|em|ste… → r-adjective; (5) en|st|te|ten|iert|iere… or vowel+t → r-verb; (6) everything else → r-adverb.
sharedRootCause.popupSide: chapter-app.js:2871 — let base = (spanRole && spanRole !== 'plain' && !hit.role) ? Object.assign({}, hit, { role: spanRole }) : hit. The occurrence role is injected ONLY when the resolved entry has no role of its own. When the entry HAS a role, the entry wins for the popup while the span keeps the guess.
sharedRootCause.consequence: the span is painted by a surface guess and the popup by a real dictionary resolution. Wherever the two disagree, HCM fires. This is not a bug in either function — each behaves exactly as documented — it is an asymmetry between them.
sharedRootCause.authoritativeSide: the POPUP. guessRole is explicitly the fallback ("Explicit role in data wins; empty or plain falls back to automatic inference", :756-759); lookupWord (:2716) performs real resolution (exact surface → lemma → declension tables). A dictionary hit outranks a spelling heuristic.
sharedRootCause.confidence: PROVEN — every rendered role below is reproduced by hand-applying guessRole to the surface
